answer: By the meadow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on time-locked work history, burned when the recruit misbehaves, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The jetty is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the haven. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
